title: ARTICLE command: extra overview DB query for did_sig_valid
description: In lifecycle.rs, both ARTICLE-by-msgid (around line 713) and ARTICLE-by-number (around line 1142) fetch article wire bytes from IPFS and then issue a separate query_by_msgid call to the overview store solely to retrieve did_sig_valid. This adds one SQLite async round-trip per ARTICLE command that was not present before DID verification. For readers doing bulk catchup (issuing hundreds of ARTICLE commands sequentially), this doubles the SQLite query count. The did_sig_valid field could instead be stored alongside the CID in the msgid_map or fetched as part of the existing CID lookup, avoiding the separate overview query. Alternatively, did_sig_valid could be stored directly in a dedicated msgid→did_sig_valid table with a single-column indexed lookup that is cheaper than a full overview row fetch.
